name: ds_gate_v1b_fixed, stage E1 rerun with fixes (three arms)
frozen_at: 2026-10-29, written before any real-data result of this stage was computed
approved_by: Omri, 2026-10-29 (project thread): run the corrected E1, and on SUB5; fix spec from the coordinating session
question: Can a label-free hierarchical Dawid-Skene model on binary GAP votes give calibrated probabilities that an ANSWER contains an error (and that each step is an error), so that a gate can mark answers clean (k = 0) before GAP?
access: CPU only, stored per-step scores and channels, no new inference; labels used only by the E1 diagnostics

cells.telemetry: PRM backbone (the AUTO setting): 16 channels N16 + the PRM
cells.populations: PRMBench: all 6,969 answers enter the fit, the 6,211 non-control answers are evaluated; ProcessBench/CRV: the evaluate_cab common set (cells loaded as in results/bracha_lr_transfer_v1/lr_transfer.py)

pipeline.step0_cleaning: answer-z of each channel, then remove a cubic in relative step position ((j+.5)/n) by pooled least squares over steps of answers with >= 2 steps, label-free; the procedure of results/prm_view_selection_v1/position_probe/probe.py (Step 481). The PRM is not residualized. Each cleaned channel is oriented by the sign of its pooled correlation with the PRM's answer-z risk.
pipeline.step1_votes: GAP binarization per answer (evaluate_collection.topk_flags with gap_counts) on the answer-z of every cleaned channel and of the PRM risk; a channel constant inside an answer votes 0 there. Votes in {0,1}.
pipeline.step2_grouping: prm_anchored_lsml.groups_from_cov on the covariance of the +-1 votes of the 17 voters (PRM + 16 channels), pooled steps; the PRM is an ordinary voter (no group of its own is imposed). Group vote = sign of the votes weighted by sml_weights_nonneg within the group (ties -> 0); singleton = its own vote. Requires K >= 3, else the cell is reported invalid.

step3_model.latent: answer state z in {clean, has-error}, P(has-error) = rho; inside a has-error answer, step label y ~ Bernoulli(pi(p)), pi(p) = logistic(a + b*p) of relative position p, conditioned on at least one error in the answer (exact likelihood); in a clean answer all y = 0
step3_model.emissions: groups conditionally independent given (z, y): P(vote=1) = psi_g on an error step, phi_g on a correct step of a has-error answer, phi0_g on a step of a clean answer (GAP forces votes in clean answers; phi0 absorbs that)
step3_model.fit: EM; M-step closed form for rho, psi, phi, phi0; a, b by 10 Newton steps of weighted logistic regression (the at-least-one normalizer is ignored in that M-step: generalized EM, likelihood monitored); probabilities clipped to [1e-4, 1-1e-4]; 5 starts (one from the vote-share posterior, four random), best final log-likelihood kept; 500 iterations max, tolerance 1e-8 on mean log-likelihood; a fit with mean(psi) < mean(phi) is reported as label-switched, never flipped after the fact
step3_model.outputs: P(has-error | votes) per answer; q_i = P(y_i = 1 | votes) per step

E1_diagnostics_labels_used: D1 answer-level prevalence: rho_hat vs the true share of evaluated answers with >= 1 error
D2 step-level prevalence: mean q vs true step error rate (ProcessBench: prefix domain, steps up to the first error)
D3 calibration of P(has-error): 10 equal-count bins, expected calibration error (ECE)

D4 gate quality at the frozen thresholds: share of has-error answers kept and share of clean answers closed; thresholds = rho_hat (ProcessBench rule) and 0.5; on PRMBench also the share of answers closed
D5 count: Spearman of sum_i q_i with the true error count, with the GAP count of the AUTO score as reference, and Spearman of sum_i q_i with answer length (number of steps)

pass_criteria_for_moving_to_E2.D1: |rho_hat - truth| <= 0.05 on ProcessBench and CRV for at least 3 of 4 PRMs
pass_criteria_for_moving_to_E2.D3: ECE <= 0.05 on ProcessBench and CRV for at least 3 of 4 PRMs
pass_criteria_for_moving_to_E2.D4: on ProcessBench at threshold rho_hat: closes >= 30% of clean answers while keeping >= 85% of has-error answers, for at least 3 of 4 PRMs; on PRMBench closes <= 5% of has-error answers
pass_criteria_for_moving_to_E2.D5: |Spearman(sum q, length)| below the GAP count's in the same cell, and Spearman(sum q, true count) above the GAP count's, in every valid cell (amendment A3)
pass_criteria_for_moving_to_E2.otherwise: stop and report; no tuning toward the criteria

not_in_E1: the decision rules (ProcessBench: rho_hat threshold, 0.5 alongside; PRMScore: the expected-cost rule P(error)*(correct flags lost) < P(clean)*(wrong flags saved), 0.5 alongside) and every comparison with GAP / k=2 / the PRM are E2, run only if E1 passes, with their own frozen protocol

amendments_before_any_real_run.date: 2026-10-29, after the independent code review (REVIEW.md) and before E1 touched real data
amendments_before_any_real_run.A1_exact_prior_update: The (a, b) update now maximizes the exact expected objective, including the at-least-one normalizer, with backtracking; the log-likelihood is monitored and drops are reported (review B1: the frozen approximation biased rho by ~0.02 and doubled ECE on synthetic data).
amendments_before_any_real_run.A2_stable_estep: Stable log forms for log(e^M - e^N), the constraint correction and the normalizer (review S1). Same model.
amendments_before_any_real_run.A3_D5_reference: D5 compares with the GAP count of the AUTO score in the same cell (both length Spearman and true-count Spearman); the constant 0.78 is dropped because it could not be traced to a stored file and is a PRMBench number (review S3).
amendments_before_any_real_run.A4_pool: Cleaning/orientation/grouping pool = all answers with >= 2 steps on every benchmark; the PRMBench control classification is no longer used anywhere before the diagnostics (review S4).
amendments_before_any_real_run.A5_verdict: An invalid (K < 3) cell counts as a failure; ECE bins are equal-count by rank; degenerate fits (rho at clip, mean phi0 > mean psi) and label switches are reported (review S2, N4, N9).
amendments_before_any_real_run.A6_declared: PRM vote uses the logit risk arm for every PRM, as AUTO does (N1); the PRM column is masked when constant within an answer (N2). On PRMBench rho is fitted over all 6,969 answers (758 controls are clean), so D1 there compares with the truth over all answers; D4 PRMBench = share of has-error answers closed (N6). ProcessBench D5 true count is 0/1 (prefix domain) (N8).

amendments_v1b_before_any_real_run.B1_orientation: Channels keep their stored pipeline orientation (E.channels as read by results/prm_view_selection_v1/stage2/stage2.py TeleCell: no flips). E1 instead flipped each channel by the sign of its pooled correlation with the PRM. The PRM risk keeps its own orientation (higher = riskier).
amendments_v1b_before_any_real_run.B2_arms: Three arms per cell. AUTO = PRM + N16 backbone telemetry (lr_transfer L.load(bench, prm, 'prm')). TELE16 = the 16 N16 channels of the standalone telemetry (L.load(bench, prm, 'sa'): each PRM's base LM run as a plain LM; available for all four benchmarks), no PRM. SUB5 = q15_H1, chosen_surprisal, top15_turnover, dominant_freq16, bocpd_p0, digit_spread of that standalone telemetry (names verified against channel_names__N16), no PRM. K < 3 makes a cell invalid (a failure).
amendments_v1b_before_any_real_run.B3_binned_prior: pi(p) = one free probability per relative-position bin (10 equal-width bins of (j+.5)/n), conditioned on >= 1 error in a has-error answer (exact normalizer); M-step: Newton with the exact gradient and backtracking on the exact expected objective. Replaces logistic a + b*p.
amendments_v1b_before_any_real_run.B4_position_cleaning: Every voter, the PRM included, is answer-z scored and residualized on the pooled cubic in relative position (Step 481) before re-standardization and GAP, so position enters only through the prior. E1 left the PRM vote position-dependent (position counted twice).
amendments_v1b_before_any_real_run.B5_rlhflow_check: RLHFlow ProcessBench c.arms['PRM'] (within-AUC 0.33 in the prefix domain) is NOT inverted: pooled AUROC 0.691, native flag AUROC 0.560, both > 0.5. Its risk falls with position (Spearman -0.43 with relative position), and the prefix-domain within-AUC is dominated by position (POS_ONLY within-AUC = 1.00, the error is always the last prefix step). Not changed.
amendments_v1b_before_any_real_run.B6_audit_step481: Position cleaning matches results/prm_view_selection_v1/position_probe/probe.py (same cubic, same (j+.5)/n, re-standardization before GAP). Differences kept: pool = all answers with >= 2 steps (probe used c.keep & len > 1; on ProcessBench c.keep comes from the gold prefix); a voter constant inside an answer votes 0 there (in the probe it would vote on the position polynomial alone). No implementation bug found beyond B4.
amendments_v1b_before_any_real_run.B7_decision_rules: Reported beside D1-D5 (no pass criterion): plain GAP flags of each arm's pipeline score (AUTO = stage8 auto L-SML on PRM + N16; TELE16 / SUB5 = L-SML on the channels) against gated flags (gated answers k = 0). Gates: P(has-error) < rho_hat; < 0.5; expected cost sum_{flagged} q_i < (1 - P(has-error)) * |flags| (q_i = P(has-error) * P(error step | has-error)). Metrics: PRMBench official PRMScore, CRV macro F1 (E.official_from_counts, as lr_transfer), ProcessBench first-error F1 (harmonic mean of accuracy on erroneous and clean answers; empty steps not modelled; plain GAP always flags so it scores 0 there).
amendments_v1b_before_any_real_run.B8_review: The coordinator asked for an independent reviewer subagent; this worker could not spawn one. Replaced by: brute-force enumeration of P(has-error), q and the log-likelihood on tiny answers (max error 7e-15), synthetic recovery of rho, the 10 bins, psi/phi/phi0 and calibration on three simulations (all pass, 0 likelihood drops), and parity of the plain-GAP metrics with stored numbers (PRMBench AUTO 69.865 vs 69.9 reported; CRV-GSM8K AUTO 49.987 = bracha_lr_transfer_v1 RESULTS.csv).
amendments_v1b_before_any_real_run.otherwise: stop and report; no tuning toward the criteria
